messages:
Nia: Quick note - saw p95 jump on /v1/stream when we flipped a routing policy. p50 unchanged, chart looks off.
Ethan: Which flip? weights or quota fallthrough?
Nia: We moved 10% traffic to slow-spot at 13:42. Panel uses merged t-digests for percentiles.
console-team: Merged t-digests + small contributor counts = unstable tails. Did you check per-backend counts?
Nia: Per-backend snapshot: main count 1100, slow-spot count 4 with latencies ~2.7s. Merged p95 jumped from 0.2s -> 1.9s.
Ethan: Classic. Low-volume heavy tail dominates merged p95 once weight crosses threshold.
agg-bot: alert: merged_p95_delta 850% for /v1/stream (detected 2025-09-02T13:43Z)
console-team: Proposal: add a confidence pill when any contributor <25 samples, show per-backend p95 inline, and offer an "Exact recompute" button that pulls raw buckets for the visible window.
Nia: Also please overlay routing weight timeline under charts so rollouts are obvious.
Ethan: For alerts: suppress merged-p95 paging when total_merged_samples < 50 and instead alert on per-backend p95 deltas.
console-team: We'll draft a tiny UI PR: confidence badge text + tooltip: "Merged percentiles may be inaccurate when contributors have very low sample counts; toggle per-backend for clarity."
Nia: Filing issue and attaching a short replay to reproduce. Thanks.
